style.prompt: Create a photorealistic billboard mockup using the two supplied images. Image 1 is the poster artwork: preserve its complete vintage Grand Canyon illustration, colors, border, lettering and layout, without cropping or redesigning. Image 2 is the base scene photograph of the Golden Gate Bridge: preserve the recognizable bridge tower, roadway, traffic, water, hills and daylight. Add one realistically constructed roadside billboard beside the bridge in the right-hand foreground, supported on metal posts on the hillside outside the roadway. The billboard display should have the portrait proportions of the supplied poster and show the entire poster from image 1, clearly visible and large enough to appreciate. Integrate the billboard naturally into the photograph with plausible scale, perspective, daylight, shadows and material texture. Keep the central bridge tower unobstructed. No other added text or logos.
